name: Pentachoron rule (in-house, 4-simplex weighting)
plain: An invented soft saturation: each group of 4 channels is projected on the 5 vertices of a 4-simplex, compressed by a softmax-like form, and returned. Small pushes behave like plain CFG.
math:
g = (w−1)(c−u); a = Vg per pixel; τ = k·RMS(a); z=a/τ
P = 4τ·Σ sinh(z_k) v_k / Σ cosh(z_j); x̂ = c + P
